title: Kubernetes Ingress & Service Pod Restart Runbook
content:
# API gateway recovery

Use this procedure when ingress traffic returns 5xx responses or API gateway pods enter a crash loop.

## Procedure
1. Confirm the incident scope and check the deployment events.
2. Inspect pod logs for the failing container.
3. Restart the deployment and watch the rollout.
4. Verify service endpoints and ingress health checks.
5. Record the change and notify the incident channel.

title: Linux SSH Server Audit & Hardening Checklist
content:
# SSH audit checklist

Review exposed sockets, confirm only approved interfaces are listening, and validate brute-force protection before handing over a host.

- [ ] Review listening services and owning processes
- [ ] Confirm root login is disabled
- [ ] Verify key-only authentication
- [ ] Check fail2ban jail status and recent bans
- [ ] Capture evidence in the engagement log

title: Customer Churn Feature Extraction Query
content:
# Training feature extraction

Build the engagement features used by the churn model. The 30-day window is anchored to each customer snapshot date.

code_block.code:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  s.snapshot_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) FILTER (WHERE e.created_at >= s.snapshot_date - INTERVAL '30 days') AS events_30d,
  MAX(e.created_at) AS last_seen_at,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id) AS invoices_90d,
  CASE WHEN MAX(e.created_at) < s.snapshot_date - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS churn_label
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_snapshots s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN engagement_events e ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, s.snapshot_date;
